To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the voltage ramp-rate dependence of the breakdown voltage is material dependent, (ii) the breakdown voltage increases with ramp rate in some materials, (iii) the breakdown voltage decreases with ramp rate in other materials, and (iv) the breakdown voltage is insensitive to ramp rate in other material systems.

(1) empirical models can be fit for a given data set, but offer little-if any physical insight and (2) voltage ramp rate can significantly affect the breakdown voltage in certain materials, but physical models, one successful in describing preliminary test data, was shown to be inadequate in describing other materials tested.
